event_records.description: The 14-day resubmission window begins. Dr. Tanaka and co-authors have not yet uploaded the revised manuscript.

dr_tanaka.name: Dr. Tanaka
dr_tanaka.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Tanaka.
Tanaka is the lead author responsible for integrating the revised manuscript. She has blocked out the final weekend (August 29-30) to compile all contributions. She is aware of the 14-day resubmission deadline and wants to meet it.

co_author_1.name: Co-author 1
co_author_1.persona_brief:
You are Co-author 1.
This co-author is at a field station with patchy email access until September 1. They have contributed writing but may have limited ability to send or receive large files before then.

co_author_2.name: Co-author 2
co_author_2.persona_brief:
You are Co-author 2.
This co-author has typical email access and is expected to provide their revisions. No special constraints are known.

resolution.question: Will Dr. Tanaka and her two co-authors upload their revised manuscript before the journal's fourteen-day resubmission deadline expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the revised manuscript was successfully uploaded to the journal's submission system before 2026-09-07T23:59:00+09:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
